questions.question: State Newton's law of gravitation. What is the gravitational constant G?
questions.solution:
**Newton's law of gravitation:** Every particle of matter attracts every other particle with a force directly proportional to the product of their masses and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between them: F = GMm/rÂ².
